cards.name: Tomorrow, Azami's Familiar
cards.oracleText: If you would draw a card, look at the top three cards of your library instead. Put one of those cards into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.

cards.name: Mysterious Tome // Chilling Chronicle
cards.oracleText:
{2}, {T}: Draw a card. Transform this artifact.
{1}, {T}: Tap target nonland permanent. Transform this artifact.

cards.name: Fool's Tome
cards.oracleText: {2}, {T}: Draw a card. Activate only if you have no cards in hand.

cards.name: Jushi Apprentice // Tomoya the Revealer
cards.typeLine: Creature — Human Wizard // Legendary Creature — Human Wizard
cards.oracleText:
{2}{U}, {T}: Draw a card. If you have nine or more cards in hand, flip this creature.
{3}{U}{U}, {T}: Target player draws X cards, where X is the number of cards in your hand.

cards.name: Mangara's Tome
cards.oracleText:
When this artifact enters, search your library for five cards, exile them in a face-down pile, and shuffle that pile. Then shuffle your library.
{2}: The next time you would draw a card this turn, instead put the top card of the exiled pile into its owner's hand.

cards.name: Mazemind Tome
cards.oracleText:
{T}, Put a page counter on this artifact: Scry 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put that card on the bottom.)
{2}, {T}, Put a page counter on this artifact: Draw a card.
When there are four or more page counters on this artifact, exile it. If you do, you gain 4 life.

cards.name: Sarevok's Tome
cards.oracleText:
When this artifact enters, you take the initiative.
{T}: Add {C}. If you have the initiative, add {C}{C} instead.
{3}, {T}: Exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland card. You may cast that card without paying its mana cost. Activate only if you've completed a dungeon.

cards.name: Tome of the Guildpact
cards.oracleText:
Whenever you cast a multicolored spell, draw a card.
{T}: Add one mana of any color.

cards.name: Urza's Tome
cards.oracleText: {3}, {T}: Draw a card. Then discard a card unless you exile a historic card from your graveyard. (Artifacts, legendaries, and Sagas are historic.)
